notes.title: Borrowhelen 1.2.0 - Regular Update
notes.notes:
Borrowhelen 1.2.0 Changelog

Note: By updating to 1.2.0, you may not be able to load old save data.

Features

 Added new voxels.
 Test chamber implementation.

You can visit the test chamber by entering "gotest" in the console.


Engine Updates

 Improved VOXELDEF from GZDoom 4.13.0.
 Engine version updated to 1.2.0.


List of New Voxels

 Barrel01mossy/old
 Barrel02explosive
 Brazier02Bronze/Iron
 Chalkboard
 GoalSignNormal
 GoalSignSecret
 Lamp03/bright
 Lamp04/bright
 Lantern01HangingS/M/L/XL
 Lantern01brightHangingS/M/L/XL
 Menu01
 Pot04
 Sign02
 Sign03
 Sign04
 Sign06
 Switch01
 Switch02
 Switch03
 Switch04


Fixes

 Updated the splash screen, credits, and welcome message in the console.
 Fixed some class names.
 Resolved sprite flickering before Cyclops' quake attack.
 Adjusted the key relief's position in E2M4.


Additions/Improvements

 Updated cliff textures in E3M6.
 Modified sector heights for smoother gameplay in E3M6.
 Enhanced the test chamber.
 Added missing decorations to the test chamber.
 Implemented condition checks for BCentaur (Centaur).

notes.title: Borrowhelen - 1.10 Regular Update
notes.notes:
Borrowhelen 1.10 Changelog

Note: By updating to 1.10, you may not be able to load old save data.

Features

 Added more voxels.
 Replaced some tracks with better, clearer versions.
 Secret hints available through the console.


Voxels
Here is the list of new voxels:

 Pot01
 Pot02
 Pot03
 Lamp01/Lamp01bright
 Lamp02/Lamp02bright
 Brazier02Brass
 Fungi02
 Mandolin
 Plant04
 Plant05
 Jug01
 Lantern01/Lantern01bright
 Lantern01handle/Lantern01brightHandle


Music
Here is the list of replaced tracks:

 BOR01C (E1M1)
 BOR05C, BOR05M (E1M5)
 BOR15C (E2M7)
 BOR17C, BOR17M (E2M9)
 BOR19C (E3M2)
 BOR25C (E3M8)
 BOR26C (E4M1)
 BOR33C (E4M8)
 E3Outro


Secret Hints
Now you can view a secret hint in each level. Here’s how to access it.
[olist]
 Open the console (` by default)
 Type "secret" and press Enter.
 The hint will appear. Red indicates undiscovered secrets, green indicates discovered secrets, and yellow indicates additional information.
 To refresh and view the latest information, simply type "secret" again.
[/olist]

Fixes

 Removed unused graphics.
 Fixed the shape of the crack and adjusted the Elixir of Life’s position in E1M1.
 Fixed a broken elevator in E1M3.
 Fixed the automap flag in E1M4.
 Fixed stove damage amount in E1M5.
 Fixed stove damage amount in E3M4.
 Fixed stove damage amount in E3M8.
 Corrected mismatched dialog for Ordin in E4M6.


Additions/Improvements

 Cleaned up code for ShowMapNameHandler.
 Cleaned up code for MusicCheckSpawner.
 Added 2 objects in E1M4.
 Added decals for smoother gameplay in E1M5.
 Changed ceiling brightness in E1M5.
 Changed waterfall opacity in E1M6.
 Added 1 object in E3M3.
 Sails are now raised in E3M4.
 Changed ceiling brightness in E3M5.
 Changed wall brightness in E4M4.
 Changed ceiling brightness in E4M5.
 Adjusted sector heights in E4M5.
